title: Code Interpreter E2E + Advanced Harness
description:
Implement code interpreter E2E scenario and advanced harness suites from docs/plans/08-agent-tools-e2e.md and 08-agent-tools-e2e-test-harness.md.

Sections: §4.5 (Code Interpreter Workflow scenario), harness §1-§10

Key deliverables:
- Scenario 4.5: Code interpreter workflow — progressive discovery, RLM sub-calls, DataStore ops, usage stats, multi-step completion, budget enforcement
- Property tests P1-P5: end-state determinism, event milestone coverage, follow-up FIFO, code interpreter trace consistency, terminal-tool short-circuit
- Fault injection F1-F5: provider interruption, tool timeout, concurrent control injection, filesystem conflict, script limit exceedance
- Comparison/oracle O1-O3: deterministic vs live-provider semantic oracle, LocalBackend vs SandboxBackend oracle, replay bundle oracle
- Deterministic simulations S1-S3: scenario state-machine, control-boundary, fixture mutator
- Benchmarks B1-B4: scenario <10s, full suite <10min, artifact overhead <5%, parallel >=3x on 4-core
- Stress/soak ST1-ST3: 12h scenario churn, multi-agent parallel, long conversation stress
- Security SEC1-SEC4: workspace containment, secret redaction, script sandbox enforcement, command safety
- Acceptance tests pass (G4 gate)

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

- Plan: docs/plans/08-agent-tools-e2e.md §4.5
- Test harness: docs/plans/08-agent-tools-e2e-test-harness.md §1-§10
